attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Kinn of the Long Grass have moved their largest settlement, leaving behind a smoldering campsite.","reason":"Briefing says there is no new news; this event is invented."},{"span":"No one claims responsibility, but the ash is fresh and the wind carries the scent of burnt sage.","reason":"Invented details about the invented event."},{"span":"their ships anchored in the bay","reason":"No ships or bay are in the briefing."},{"span":"The Ashen Hand have not made a move in weeks.","reason":"Unsupported timeframe; the briefing gives no such period."},{"span":"Some say they’re waiting, others say they’re tired.","reason":"Invented rumours attributed to sources."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":1,"comment":"It breaks the format with a 'News since your last bulletin:' heading and invents a Kinn relocation, even though the briefing says nothing new happened. It also adds ships and a bay that are not in the briefing, and the voice lacks Ilse's dry wit."}
